item.title: Livonia High School closed Feb. 13 due to water main break
item.description: Livonia High School will be closed on Friday, Feb. 13 due to a broken water main, and students are not expected to complete assignments from home.

item.title: East Baton Rouge Parish Mayor Sid Edwards calls for review of parish finances
item.description: East Baton Rouge Mayor-President Sid Edwards is asking the Louisiana Legislative Auditor to conduct an independent review of financial and operational practices within the City-Parish of East Baton Rouge, saying the move is aimed at transparency and rebuilding public confidence in local government.

item.title: Angel Army brings fentanyl warning to Central High School, demonstrates how Narcan can save lives
item.description: Angel Army, a group made up of parents who lost children to fentanyl, is bringing its message directly to students in the Baton Rouge area.

item.title: Baton Rouge General doctors stress 'every minute matters' during a heart attack
item.description: Cardiologists at Baton Rouge General say knowing the warning signs of a heart attack and acting fast can mean the difference between life and death.

item.title: Qualifying for Louisiana May 16 party primary election continues
item.description: Here's the latest on candidates qualifying for U.S. Senate and congressional districts covering the Baton Rouge area.

item.title: LDH launches new initiative to reduce maternal deaths linked to substance use
item.description: The new initiative, called Project M.O.M., which stands for maternal overdose mortality, will create person-centered care for mothers impacted by substance use disorder within a statewide system of care.

item.title: Mayor Edwards seeks audit of city-parish finances amid transparency concerns
item.description: Mayor-President Sid Edwards announced that the Louisiana Legislative Auditor will be reviewing the City-Parish government's financial operations in response to public concerns over potential misuse of public funds.

item.title: Orleans Parish inmate escapee Antoine Massey sentenced for kidnapping, rape
item.description: Orleans Parish inmate-escapee Antoine Massey was sentenced to 60 years in prison Thursday, Feb. 12 for the kidnapping and rape of his former girlfriend.

item.title: One dead, four injured in shooting at Hammond apartment complex: TPSO
item.description: The Tangipahoa Parish Sheriff's Office is investigating a shooting at the Willow Villa apartment complex that left one man dead and four people, including a 3-year-old, injured on Thursday, Feb. 12.
